## Summary

[Partial] Inspect door arm rest for hidden screws and use a panel tool to pop out perimeter fasteners. [t454]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Inspect the door arm rest area to locate screws hidden under small covers with slots.
2. [Partial] Use a dedicated panel tool or similar implement from an auto parts store to pop out fasteners around the perimeter of the door panel.
